fixpointInitialiseVariables() - Method in interface fr.sorbonne_u.components.cyphy.plugins.devs.interfaces.ModelCI
initialise the model variables with a more elaborated protocol when external model variables depend of each others, hence models importing variables have to wait until these variables are themselves initialised so this protocol will allow to call repetitively the method until all variables are initialised without having to respect any order among models (but models cannot have circular dependencies); this method must be called after the method initialiseState.
fixpointInitialiseVariables() - Method in interface fr.sorbonne_u.components.cyphy.plugins.devs.interfaces.SimulatorCI

freshness(Instant) - Method in class fr.sorbonne_u.alasca.physical_data.ComposedSignalData
for composed signal data, the freshness is defined as the duration between current and the earliest time stamp among the ones of single signal data contained in this composed signal data and recursively within every composed signal data it may contain.
freshness() - Method in class fr.sorbonne_u.alasca.physical_data.TimedEntity

return the freshness of the timed entity against current.
freshness() - Method in interface fr.sorbonne_u.alasca.physical_data.TimingI
return the freshness of the timed entity; if only one timing exists, the freshness is the duration between its time stamp and the current instant but when there are many timings, the freshness is the largest between the time stamps and the current time, both to be interpreted under the time reference.
